proposals: Counter 282 (sites 360-368): after outages on 2025-11-24/25, 2026-05-24/25 and 2026-08-11/12 the camera dumps its buffered counts into a single slot at recovery (133, 117 and 271 bikes across zones, in proportion to each zone's usual level). These are kept, as they keep weekly totals right; a 'spread_backlog' action that redistributes such a dump over the preceding zero stretch in proportion to the usual profile would fix the hourly shape and the few cases where the gap crosses a week boundary (2026-05-24 Sunday night, ~1 h).

summary: One Secure Agility camera (counter 282) covers nine zones at Sunnyholt Rd / Devitt St, Blacktown; its feed omits zero slots and days (heavily from mid-2025), so all sites are zero-filled. Counter-wide outages that publish zeros (notably 2024-01-12 to 2024-03-05 and 2023-07-26 to 08-01) are set missing, while later outages that end in a catch-up dump are kept since weekly totals stay right. A sudden, lasting doubling on the crossing and east footpath zones from 2024-11-07 has no evident mechanism and is flagged uncertain.
